lines.zh: 我走过走廊，脚步声很轻。
lines.en: I cross the corridor with light steps.
I stop at each step, as if counting doors.

lines.zh: 我从灯下走进没有灯的那段。
lines.en: I walk from under a lamp into the unlit stretch.
Patch after patch on my hide.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖在身后，不太对劲。
lines.en: My shadow trails behind me. Something's off.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，避开灯下。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, out of the lamplight.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气凉了一点。
lines.en: The air cools a little where I pass.
I take half a circuit of the room.

lines.zh: 我在门口停了一下，再往里。
lines.en: I pause at the doorway, then go in.
I walk and keep looking back.

lines.zh: 我走向那个有声音的方向。
lines.en: I head toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我最后站在你几步之外。
lines.en: I stop a few paces from you.
I stand still and watch you.
I tilt my head as if trying to recognize something.
I say nothing. I only stand.

lines.zh: 我在数你眼皮动了几次。
lines.en: I'm counting your eyelid's trips.

lines.zh: 我的气息轻得几乎没有。
lines.en: My breath is almost nothing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，灯光在我身上不动。
lines.en: I hold still and the light on me holds still too.
I'll wait for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看，又放下。
lines.en: I raise a hand, look at it, and lower it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没有移开。
lines.en: My eyes haven't moved off you.
I've stood in this corner a long while.

lines.zh: 我像在听什么很远的东西。
lines.en: I seem to be listening to something far away.

lines.zh: 我不急，我可以等到天亮。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry. I can wait till dawn.

lines.zh: 我的影子先动，我才跟上。
lines.en: My shadow moves first; then I follow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重量挪到另一只脚。
lines.en: I shift my weight slowly to the other foot.
You turned around. I'm here.
I know you heard me.
No need to ask what I am.

lines.zh: 补丁缝成的我，你大概听过。
lines.en: You've likely heard of me, the stitched one.
I didn't come to make conversation.
Stay where you are. Don't move.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你的手，别藏。
lines.en: I have been watching your hands; do not hide them.
Hold that lamp up a bit.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里，只有我们两个。
lines.en: In this building, there's only us two.

lines.zh: 你别笑，我不喜欢那个表情。
lines.en: Don't smile. I don't like that expression.

lines.zh: 我数到十，你还站在这儿。
lines.en: I'll count to ten and you'll still be here.
When you run, I won't move at first.
I can wait. Waiting is what I do best.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚才比现在长。
lines.en: Your shadow was longer a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我走近一步，你就明白了。
lines.en: One step closer and you'll understand.
Why don't you make a sound?

lines.zh: 这栋旧楼，今晚不会有别人。
lines.en: No one else will come to this old building tonight.
I know what's in your hand.
Let's stand here a moment longer.

lines.zh: 这样就够了，你不用再走。
lines.en: This is enough; you don't need to walk on.
I step back without a sound.
That hurt your hand more.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙，慢慢转回来对着你。
lines.en: I brace on the wall and turn back to face you.
There's a tear in my coat.
I cover the wound and keep watching.
It hurts. I stay silent.
I lean on the wall a moment.
My breath has grown heavier by degrees.
You hit harder than I expected.

lines.zh: 衣服破了一道，我记下了。
lines.en: A tear in my coat — noted.

lines.zh: 你脚跟往后挪，我看见了。
lines.en: Your heel slides back; I see it.
That little light doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 你举得再高，光也照不到我。
lines.en: Raise it higher; the light still won't reach me.
I've stopped at the edge of the light.
Brighter won't help.
You locked the door? I heard.
The door is over there. Locked.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙，一点一点靠近。
lines.en: I creep along the wall, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我走过走廊，脚步轻得听不见。
lines.en: I walk the corridor so light you cannot hear me.
Fine. I won't come closer.
A hide stitched from patches does not come apart.
I didn't yield an inch.
No one stands at my back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，补丁对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, my patches facing you.
Your hand is shaking now.
I step back half a pace. Slowly.
My shoulder is hard.
You nearly hit the wall.
I'll stand. You go around.
Good. Stop right there.
That's not what I'm here for.
There's nothing else in this building.
You're asking the wrong person.
All I do is follow people.

lines.zh: 你站得近，我就记住你了。
lines.en: Stand close and I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 我不说话，不代表我没听。
lines.en: Not speaking doesn't mean I didn't hear.
That lamp is about to die.
Best not to turn your back.
I've never left your side.

lines.zh: 这一夜不会短，你站得近，我就记住你。
lines.en: This night will be long; stand close and I will remember you.
I stoop and pick it up.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我替你捡了。
lines.en: I picked up what you dropped.
I hold it under the lamp to look closely.
I'm not giving it back.

lines.zh: 地板上还散着几样东西。
lines.en: A few more things lie scattered on the floor.
I pick them up one at a time.
I put it in my coat pocket.

lines.zh: 这东西上还留着你的手汗。
lines.en: Your hand-sweat is still on this.
I've picked it all up and I'm still looking.
Right. This is mine now.
You moved, so I follow.
I've fixed on you, right behind.

lines.zh: 这层楼只有一道楼梯口。
lines.en: This floor has only one stairwell.
I'm standing at the door.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I hear your breathing perfectly.
I'm in no hurry. I come slowly.
The lights are going out one by one.
Look back and I'll still be there.
No one comes to this floor.

lines.zh: 我在数还有多少声脚步。
lines.en: I'm counting how many footsteps are left.
Your hand has found the handle.
That door is locked.
Good. I've picked you out.

lines.zh: 我不喊，走廊会把声音传给你。
lines.en: I don't shout; the corridor carries it for me.
Along this corridor.
Come this way.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，跟着你的节奏。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, matching your pace.
You halt, I halt.
I walk in the gaps between lamps.

lines.zh: 你的影子被灯拉得朝我这边。
lines.en: The lamp stretches your shadow toward me.
I count how many lamps are left.
You hesitated at the corner.
I make my steps even lighter.
The floorboards on this floor give you away.

lines.zh: 我只剩三步，脚步没声音。
lines.en: Three steps left, and my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 我身上那块补丁，是缝上去的。
lines.en: This patch on me was stitched on.
There's no wall behind you. There is in front.

lines.zh: 你听到的第二个脚步声是我。
lines.en: That second set of footsteps is me.
I needn't run. You can't go fast either.
I'll wait at that corner.
Only a few lamps left.
A few more steps and you're at the end.

lines.zh: 我听见衣料摩擦的声音。
lines.en: I hear cloth rubbing.
Right before my eyes.
I've stayed at your back throughout.
To the end of this corridor.
I reach out. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你退开之前，我已经碰到了。
lines.en: Before you pulled back, I'd touched you.
That one didn't even make a sound.
My palms are ice-cold.
You struck empty air.
I've pressed you to the wall.
In a single instant.
I take hold and let go.
You fall back and I stop.
I'll wait for you to come close again.
That was a reminder.
Not one step moved — still right here.
There's blood on your hands. Not mine.
I can outlast you.
On this floor, only you and me.
Right. I'll hold still.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋里出来，没有声音。
lines.en: I come out of the egg without a sound.
The building has one more in it now.

lines.zh: 我先站在角落里，看了看。
lines.en: I stand in the corner first and look.
In that flicker of the light, I'm here.
There are my prints on the floor.
The corridor is long. I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 这里安静得能听见水管。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear the pipes.
I closed the door behind me.

lines.zh: 我数了数这层有几间屋子。
lines.en: I count the rooms on this floor.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在墙上，不太对。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the wall. Something's off.
I reach out and touch the wall.
This place is very old.
I'll stand here until someone comes.

lines.zh: 有人走路的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear footsteps. Someone's walking.
I turn the corner slowly.

lines.zh: 这层楼只有一盏灯亮着。
lines.en: Only one lamp is lit on this floor.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在墙之间回响。
lines.en: My breathing echoes between the walls.
The night is long. I'm in no hurry.
Right. Here I am.
Don't turn around.

lines.zh: 火光照着我的脸，你没看清吧。
lines.en: Firelight on my face. You didn't see it clearly, did you.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，落在下一层。
lines.en: I fall down the stairwell to the floor below.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头，我还在看。
lines.en: Water covers my head and I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整层楼的灯都震灭了。
lines.en: The blast puts out every lamp on the floor.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在门框上，离我很近。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the doorframe, close to me.
That force holds me in place.
I'm hungry, but I can wait.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，整栋楼亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole building flares.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有走廊，也没有门。
lines.en: No corridor in the void. No doors.
